AlphaGenome Atlas — the download page's own artifact classification
======================================================================

Source URL : https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/terms
Saved from a signed-in browser on 2026-09-10 as `Terms of Use _ AlphaGenome.html`.
The complete page is beside this file as `alphagenome_download_page.html.gz`:
  sha256 (uncompressed) : 2bc9a5c787799bbcee67bdd8f89767322d1f82583c018e3c1d23690e31025fac
  bytes  (uncompressed) : 7,179,794

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (RM195). The AlphaGenome Services Additional Terms define a
'Permissive Use Downloadable Artifact' class and grant it commercial use, then delegate
MEMBERSHIP of that class to the download section of the Atlas website. None of the four
terms documents pinned beside this one says which artifacts are in it, and the page is a
sign-in-gated single-page app that serves navigation chrome to curl. So the single most
consequential claim about this source — that AVI may be used commercially — rested on a
reading the repository could not verify, and `SourceRow.commercial_use` shipped as None.

The page carries its content as embedded JSON rather than as markup. The two headings and
their artifact lists, extracted verbatim:

  Permissive Use Downloadable artifacts for commercial and non-commercial use
      - AVI SNV scores
          size : 88.5 GB
          file : avi_scores_snvs_tabix.zip
          desc : AVI scores and Phred-scaled scores in Tabix format

  Downloadable artifacts for non-commercial use only
      - AlphaGenome SNV merged splicing scores
          size : 20.6 GB
          file : combined_splicing_snvs_tabix.zip
          desc : AlphaGenome merged splicing scores in Tabix format
      - AVI SNV feature importance scores
          size : 283.9 GB
          file : avi_feature_importances_snvs_tabix.zip
          desc : AVI SHAP feature importance scores in Tabix format

READ AGAINST THE TERMS:

  AVI SNV scores                  -> Permissive: commercial AND non-commercial use
  AlphaGenome SNV merged splicing -> non-commercial only
  AVI SNV feature importance      -> non-commercial only

This is the whole basis for `alphagenome_avi` carrying commercial_use=True, and for the
AVI lane refusing the other two artifacts by name. It confirms the reading the probe
recorded in ALPHAGENOME_ATLAS.md § 1 rather than overturning it.

IT DOES NOT ANSWER `redistribution`. The classification is about USE. Prohibition 1 of the
Output Terms separately bars sharing with a commercial organization 'aside from indirectly
via a scientific publication, open source release or to support journalism', and whether a
HuggingFace-published snapshot is an 'open source release' is a reading of Google's terms
that nothing here settles. `redistribution` stays None.


CITING IT. The credit line on `alphagenome_avi`'s SourceRow is the paper rather than a URL:

    Avsec, Latysheva, Cheng, Novati, Taylor, Ward, Bycroft, Nicolaisen, Arvaniti, Pan, Thomas,
    Dutordoir, Perino, De, Karollus, Gayoso, Sargeant, Mottram, Wong, Drotar, Kosiorek, Senior,
    Tanburn, Applebaum, Basu, Hassabis and Kohli. "Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction
    with AlphaGenome." Nature 649(8099):1206-1218, 2026. doi:10.1038/s41586-025-10014-0

Recorded here because the project's own `references.md` on GitHub is stale as of 2026-09-10 and the
maintainer supplied the current list from the documentation site. The three works AlphaGenome's
references also cite, for anyone tracing what it builds on: GTEx Consortium (Science 369:1318,
2020), Jaganathan et al. SpliceAI (Cell 176:535, 2019), and Linder et al. Borzoi (Nature Genetics,
2025).
